falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 25 for 2 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The BLOWOFF SCORE of 40 suggests controlled volatility/complacency; sustained VIX above 25 would confirm fear-driven liquidation rather than the capitulation-then-stabilization pattern seen in August 2024 bottoms, invalidating the bottom formation thesis

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield breaks above 4.75% and holds for 3+ days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The August 2024 bottom coincided with yields peaking and reversing; if yields break materially higher instead, it signals the macro driver (rates/fiscal stress) is accelerating not stabilizing, making the pattern match structurally invalid as the fundamental backdrop diverges

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
